title: When the Sigil Wakes
author: Mirabel Ashgrove
blurb: Paloma Brightwater, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
